heading: Conditions for solemnization of Hindu marriage
title: Conditions for solemnization of Hindu marriage
text: A Hindu marriage may be solemnized in accordance with the customary rites and ceremonies if: (a) at the time of marriage, neither party has a spouse living; (b) neither party is incapable of giving valid consent due to unsoundness of mind; (c) the parties have completed eighteen years of age; and (d) the parties are not within degrees of prohibited relationship (Sapinda relationship).

heading: Registration of Hindu marriages (Shaadipattar)
title: Registration of Hindu marriages (Shaadipattar)
text: Every marriage solemnized under this Act shall be registered with the Marriage Registrar appointed by the local government, and the Marriage Registrar shall issue a certificate of marriage (Shaadipattar) to the parties.

heading: Termination of Hindu marriage
title: Termination of Hindu marriage
text: Any Hindu husband or wife may present a petition to the Family Court praying for dissolution of marriage by a decree of termination on grounds of desertion for not less than two years, conversion to another religion, cruelty, incurable insanity, or venereal disease.
